comparison.objective: Candidate fractures and collects HELICOIL tangs; record performs a scale eccentricity test at the center and four platter corners.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires impact-force control and small-fragment recovery; record requires repeated precise placement and relocation of a 1 kg calibration weight across unmarked positions.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures and complete containment without damage; record evidence names all five test positions but omits measurement tolerances, ordering, and reporting criteria.
comparison.reason: Metrology weight placement across multiple points is a different tested ability; sparse rubric detail does not suggest overlap.
